To directly evaluate the alignment between generated floor plans and language instructions, we conduct human evaluations on a subset of the T2D test set, which consists of 100 randomly sampled instructions written by different annotators. For this purpose, we invite 5 volunteers with NLP backgrounds to evaluate the degree of alignment between source language instructions and target floor plans.
guideline: Each volunteer is asked to provide four ratings on a scale of 1 to 5 for room types, locations, sizes, and relationships alignment, and also justify whether the generated floor plan meets all specifications.
Volunteers rate four partial alignment criteria (room types, locations, sizes, relationships) on a 1‑to‑5 scale

Specifically, we consider four partial alignment criteria in terms of room types, locations, sizes, and relationships. Each volunteer is asked to provide four ratings on a scale of 1 to 5, according to the above-mentioned alignment criteria, respectively. Besides, we also consider global alignment and ask our volunteers to justify whether the generated floor plan meets all the specifications in the instructions.
